items.body_html: the pipeline runs after L1 authorization and before the atomic commit — a block changes no state and burns no round
only the HANDLE commit writes instance.round (in the same CAS window as current_step/version); round_of(transcript) must equal it

items.name_html: inline declarative/packaged only in L2 core
items.body_html: L2 core executes only inline declarative.* / packaged pairflow.* evaluators; a process-implementation (⇒ L2a) or deferred (⇒ a later lifecycle slice) evaluator is a valid declaration but rejected at run
the pipeline order is authored; evaluation stops at the first block, and a later gate runs only after every earlier gate returned allow

an evaluator reads config + the projection and returns a decision; it may not mutate instance state or the transcript, nor keep private state across rounds — any counter-like value is derived from transcript/instance/read-model state
